Nine blocking defects (B1-B9) then survived to assembly because each seat audited its own fragment and no audit ran on the assembled bytes: a wrong ratio (200 m vs 10 m ground = 20x, text says ten times, C02-entry-b.md:98); a count its own command cannot produce (C04-entry-header.md:115 '2 files / 3 lines' vs grep -rn 'cartograph' = 2); a false source-accusation against a verbatim quote (C02-entry-b.md:36,:501 vs naming-systems.md:70); a mis-anchored workshop ladder certified by its own audit row (C02-entry-b.md:248,:421 vs craft-artisan-lexicon.md:44,:54-65); two wrong section pointers (C03-entry-c.md:79,:184; C01-entry-a.md:298); a worked example with three incompatible update rules (C03-entry-c.md:123,:137,:150; C14-example.md:11 FAIL F-1, and DR-CT- count in section 11 = 0, F-2); an ownership claim that never answers cosmography's competing definition at cosmology-cosmography.md:27; and a 'per form' table covering 5 of the 8 forms (C03-entry-c.md:95-103 vs C01-entry-a.md:238-249). Trimming the assembly from 854 to 790 did not bring it into band, so the failure is design-time, not a late edit. The topic remains fresh and unowned at a01405d; the defect is entry quality, not coverage.
